desc: Pampa Energia is an Argentine power generator that also produces gas and oil in Vaca Muerta and owns petrochemicals.
markets: Argentine power, Vaca Muerta gas and petrochemicals.
rationale: Energy producer with no consumer brand; a possible Argentine race return is the only angle.

desc: Paramount Resources produces natural gas and liquids in Alberta and British Columbia, mainly Grande Prairie and the Willesden Green area.

desc: DOF Group operates offshore support and subsea construction vessels serving oil, gas and renewable energy customers worldwide.

desc: Transportadora de Gas del Sur runs Argentina's southern gas pipeline network and processes natural gas liquids.

desc: Viva Energy owns the Geelong refinery and supplies fuel through the Shell-branded retail network and Coles Express stations in Australia.
